hypotheses.R0_fullspace_clusters_recur: At least two views beat coordinate-binding null p95 in at least six layers in the uncompressed space.
hypotheses.R1_rank64_was_adequate: At least 75% of atlas view-layer cells retained at least 0.50 replication energy in the frozen rank-64 compressor.
hypotheses.R2_one_fullspace_ontology_spans_views: Median adjusted Rand agreement among the three full-space views is at least 0.50 in at least six layers.
hypotheses.R3_discrete_fullspace_codes_beat_continu: Frozen centroid reconstruction beats a rank-matched continuous subspace in at least half of view-layer cells.
hypotheses.R4_fullspace_candidates_exist: At least eight full-space clusters have center cosine at least 0.75 and at least 50 members in both panels.
hypotheses.R5_late_layers_are_more_canonical: Mean full-space center recurrence in L16/L17 exceeds the L0-L12 mean by at least 0.10 in at least two views.
